profile.bio:
Regina D. Wright writes sweet, closed-door romance about grown people finding their way back to the table.

Her stories live in small Southern towns where the tea stays cold, the casserole dishes come home full, and the whole community has an opinion about who ought to be sitting next to whom come Sunday. She writes Black women who are already whole when love finds them, and the men who finally learn to cross the room. No villains, no silly misunderstandings, just two people each carrying something, a town that notices everything, and the kind of happy ending you could hand to your mama.

Regina is the author of the Marigold Brothers series, beginning with Save Room, with a new book landing every month. She believes the truest love stories are told in small things: how a man builds his daughter’s plate, how a woman takes her coffee, who saved you a seat.

You can find her at reginadwright.com, where she shares new releases, her blog, and the occasional thing straight out of her own kitchen.
